contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Compute initial * pow(1 + rate, periods), then subtract initial. Return the change, not the final amount. Do not round.
contract.domain: Initial is between 0 and 1000; rate is between -0.5 and 0.5; periods is an integer from 0 through 20.
contract.outputRole: compounded final amount minus starting amount
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.
